data_product_description: Prescribing analysis reports provide insight into the volume and cost of prescribing for commissioners, providers, and practices, with options for ICB and national analysis. They offer monthly and quarterly datasets with up to 60 rolling months of data, reflecting current geographical structures to support ongoing monitoring and financial oversight.
data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Prescribing analysis reports provides information about volume and cost of prescribing which has taken place for primarily a Commissioner / Provider or Practice during the reporting period.

Some reports provide integrated care board (ICB) and England analysis.

Monthly and quarterly datasets are available.

The content of the reports is based on current geography structure. The data will change each month as the geography structure changes.

The system will hold 60 rolling months data which will be updated on a monthly basis.
